docs.text:
Colebrooke’s translation of the Līlāvatī and Bījagaṇita of Bhāskara II and the mathematical chapters of Brahmagupta, with his dissertation on Indian algebra.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Gerstein Science Information Centre, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Algebra, with Arithmetic and mensuration, from the Sanscrit of Brahmegupta and Bháscara. Translated by Henry Thomas Colebrooke · Brahmagupta, 7th cent, Bhaskaracarya, b. 1114, Colebrooke, H. T. (Henry Thomas), 1765-1837 · 1817, 478 scanned pages. Published 1817; Henry Thomas Colebrooke died 1837; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
